name: The Barrow Warden
_doc: The M1 DUNGEON BOSS example (the last room of the Barrow, a party of up to five). Phase 1 tests the tank (a stacking rend: swap at 3) and everyone's feet (a rotating cross). At 70% it raises a ward and calls barrow hounds: kill them AND light the three braziers to break the ward and expose it. Phase 2 is a NEW health bar with an interruptible heal, a get-in-close donut and safe-spot circles; the lever drops the portcullis on it once. Hard enrage at 6 minutes.

onUse.say: The portcullis crashes down on the Warden!

pull: Who disturbs the sleep of the barrow?
say.reset: The Warden returns to its vigil.

grave_cross.name: Grave Cross
grave_cross.say: Lines of grave-light split the floor!

lantern_sweep.name: Lantern Sweep
lantern_sweep.say: The lantern swings wide — hide behind a pillar!

mourning_toll.name: Mourning Toll
mourning_toll.say: The Warden begins the Mourning Toll — stop it!

onInterrupt.say: The toll cracks and falls silent.

actions.say: The toll mends the Warden's wounds.

close_ward.name: Drawing Ward
close_ward.say: The ward pulls inward — stand close to the Warden!

shelter.name: Barrow Wind
shelter.say: A barrow wind rises — get into the light!

phases.name: The Ward
phases.say: Rise, hounds of the barrow! The ward will hold!

onEnter.say: Light the three braziers to break the ward!

phases.name: Unbound
phases.say: You have broken my ward. Now I am unbound!

do.say: The ward shatters! The Warden reels!
